cases.method: sha256 of reference, scene, final image vs ACTIVE_STATIC_ART.json
cases.pass_criteria: all three exist and full sha256 match
cases.failure_rule: record state_mismatch; do not cite the state file until corrected

cases.method: isolated copy reopen + render with recorded command; compare sha/tolerance
cases.pass_criteria: reproduction record exists, bound to the same image sha
cases.failure_rule: mark source_image_binding unverified; do not claim packaging

cases.method: outliner/hidden-collection/GN instance/material/image-texture sweep + full-frame corner inspection
cases.pass_criteria: no tree, leaf, grass, flower, shrub, moss, vine, weed, planter, bare soil or plant texture in final image
cases.failure_rule: remove asset and its instances; re-check references; rerun full-frame inspection

cases.method: left tree zone and right cylinder zone crops; check purpose, base contact, doors/ports and shadow
cases.pass_criteria: left zone reads as maintenance cabinet group (2-3 modules, grounded, readable openings); right zone reads as closed cylindrical vessel (lid, support ring, few ports); neither floats
cases.failure_rule: revise massing/grounding; keep one hypothesis per batch

cases.method: same-camera crops at stairs / equipment base / planter base; judge three value bands and contact shadows
cases.pass_criteria: each named crop shows readable lit face, shaded face and contact shadow in the same direction as reference

cases.failure_rule: never gates; requires I3 mask calibration before any threshold

cases.method: recompute weighted total from six dimension scores; check >=85 and each >=3; verify 8 hard gates and 4 combo checks present
cases.pass_criteria: arithmetic consistent; thresholds met; evidence strings >=20 chars; report fields complete
cases.failure_rule: block end; return to rework with named dimension or gate
